Evidence_in_Project: Different preprocessing/crop/mirror/AU rules between training, eval, and WebSocket vs REST caused degraded live predictions (webcam_fix_log.md Session 1).
Mitigation: Unified /frame, /frame-json, /ws, /ws/webcam, /multimodal & benchmark_webcam.py on WebcamService.process_frame (100% parity on 916/916 frames); unified ResNet-18 loader & crop via live_resnet18_demo.py; removed AU rules (MELD val F1 0.2872 -> 0.3868).

Risk: Domain Shift (Lab/TV Frames vs Live Webcam)
Evidence_in_Project: MELD-trained EfficientNet-B0 achieved 15.6% pooled (1/9 clips) on personal webcam clips and 20.4% on RAF-DB; RAF-DB ResNet-18 jumped to 44.0% (4/9) but confused anger/fear with surprise/disgust (101 surp-vs-ang).
Mitigation: Mixed RAF-DB + aligned RAVDESS crop fine-tuning (extra_share=0.2, MixedAugmenter with 30% glasses occlusion, JPEG/blur/gamma jitter) raised webcam pooled acc to 57.3% (5/9 clips) and RAF-DB F1 to 0.7077; fallback to resnet18_raf preserved.

Evidence_in_Project: Single-run eval showed resnet18_raf p95 at 110.55 ms under prior load, risking dropped frames at 20 FPS.
Mitigation: 320x180 JPEG85 stream canvas, WebSocket transport, in-flight isProcessing drop lock, unified 200-frame CPU benchmark confirms p50=31.5-33.6 ms and p95=33.3-35.8 ms (<150 ms budget).

Evidence_in_Project: Live camera & microphone stream sensitive biometric/speech data; debug capture could write frames if left enabled.
Mitigation: 100% volatile RAM processing (temporary_upload_file deletes temp files on exit); WEBCAM_DEBUG_CAPTURE is opt-in only; neutral calibration buffer lives only in client_states RAM; UI displays scientific disclaimer.

Evidence_in_Project: MELD is 47% neutral (disgust/fear <3%); uncalibrated baseline fusion had ECE=0.2130 and audio baseline collapsed to 0.1771 Macro-F1.
Mitigation: WeightedRandomSampler (1/n_c), StrongerAudioClassifier, missing-modality key_padding_mask, entropy reliability gates, and post-hoc Temperature Scaling (ECE 0.2130 -> 0.0734).
